name: Account memory
note: Saved memories and past chats in your account
summary: The assistant keeps saved memories about the user, and can refer to past chats or searches, in the user's account on the vendor's servers. It follows the user across devices and products signed in to the same account, and settings let the user turn references off or edit and delete memories.
how: The assistant saves preferences and facts to the user's account
Past chats or searches stay available for reference
Relevant memories are pulled into context on new requests
Settings let the user turn references off and edit or delete memories
facts: ChatGPT memory (also used by dots), Perplexity memory (used by Comet)
Vendor's servers, tied to the account rather than the device
Follows you across devices, but is held by the vendor
goodFor: One memory across desktop, mobile and browser
watchOut: Old or wrong memories keep influencing answers until removed
